anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to the BIDS standard, which is a technical specification used to organize and share EEG data like the one in this dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels positioned according to the standard 10-20 montage. Sampling rate was 256 Hz with a line frequency of 60 Hz. The experimental paradigm employed a 9x8 checkerboard visual stimulus presentation with target and non-target event classifications. Trial intervals were defined from 0 to 1.0 seconds, and within-subject calibration-then-test cross-validation was applied for evaluation.
